question: Which of the following has been awarded “Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021” for Wrestling?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Kumar Dahiya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya:-**

 
 
• ​Ravi Kumar Dahiya is an Indian freestyle wrestler who won a silver medal in the men's 57 kg freestyle wrestling at the 2020 Summer Olympics. He is the first Indian wrestler to win a medal at the Olympic Games in over two decades.
 
• **Ravi Kumar Dahiya has been awarded the "Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021" for Wrestling. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• Dahiya is also a two-time Asian champion and a Commonwealth Games gold medalist. He is widely regarded as one of the best wrestlers in the world in his weight category.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sunil Chhetri:-**

 
 
• He is an Indian professional footballer who plays as a striker or winger for Indian Super League club Bengaluru FC and the Indian national team, captaining both.
 
• He is often referred to as "Captain Fantastic".
 
 
 
• **Manpreet Singh Pawar:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian field hockey player.
 
• He led the Indian field hockey team to the bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics. He plays as a halfback.
 
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian track and field athlete who is the reigning Olympic champion and World champion in the javelin throw.
 
• He is the first Asian athlete to win an Olympic gold medal and the first Asian to win gold in his event at the World Championship.
